input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Advance research/grid-linopf: score the method of record (frozen repair, reactive stage, rule CF) on the 33-case confirmation split, as the 2026-11-23 CF outcome's Next asked

doc_friction.issue: The _R.json parts store only the AC check of the reactive-stage point, not the point (pg, vg), so continuing from it meant rerunning IPOPT (100 to 760 s per case); storing the point would save that.
pyenv.py found python3.13 with pypower/clarabel but cyipopt needed IPOPT from apt (coinor-libipopt-dev) plus pip; ipopt_nlp.py's docstring says so, the cloud-session notes do not.

goal: Programme step: confirm the adopted cost-phase rule on cases no rule was set on
notes: Plan with predictions M0 to M6 committed (fc35d6fca) before the scored run. Result: 18 of 18 reruns reproduce; CF lowers the cost of all 18 confirmation finishers, never dearer than CP (cheaper on 10, sign test P = 0.002), mean gap +0.767 to +0.662 points, median +0.115 to +0.089; on reactive-stage points CP is stuck on 7 of 8 (all rounds empty QPs), CF moves all 8. M5 refuted (arm J mean +1.139 against +1.000). Local checks: run_workflow_locally --for-changes 6 of 7 workflows passed before the run record was filled (the 7th failed only on this record's empty outcome); research/infra-dcopf tests 105 passed; build.py ok; check_md_links, check_posts, research_live_links ok. Run time about 75 min on 4 processes.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a power-systems researcher scripting, running and writing up a pre-registered 18-case confirmation on 2,000-3,000-bus cases

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
